criteria.criteria: Clear presentation of course objectives and an organized lesson
Clarity of instruction and effective use of class time and pacing
Uses multimedia, the board and course materials effectively to support the lecture
Overall effectiveness of instructional delivery and classroom environment
Course materials and delivery are accessible to all students
Observer's qualitative feedback and constructive notes
